notes.title: GeoDepths Update 1.2 & Dev Log #15
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Update 1.2 is available now to play on the main Steam branch!
Featuring new depths, caves, resources, collectables, machines, and whole new ending!
[url=discord.gg/tv9XvXB5n6]Join the discord[/url] to send any feedback or bug reports. 

Check out the dev log to see all the changes.

[previewyoutube=_dnqs1_lFdc;full][/previewyoutube]

Detailed Change Log
[list]
[*] Expanded 800m depth level to be a fully mineable level.
[*] Added 800m depth caves and scannables.
[*] Added new resources to be found at 800m depth.
[*] Added new 1000m depth level, with special endgame caves and resources.
[*] Added a third ending, including a Steam achievement.
[*] Added a fourth alien artifact that is required to access the ending cave.
[*] Added alien logs.
[*] Added two new 800m depth level cave terrariums to the Item Dispenser.
[*] Added alien style models to the Item Dispenser.
[*] Tweaked drill upgrades to incorporate new higher-level resources.
[*] Added buildable Map Table.
[*] Added buildable Auto Drill Machine.
[*] Made PDA open to log when it's scanned.
[*] Added more HUB and Drill music tracks.
[*] Added Critical Mining Drill tool.
[*] Made the gems added in 1.1 scanned by default (so they're not required to be found for 100% completion).
[*] Changed the gems to spawn in the main maps as well as the unstable passage maps.
[*] Added in-game time tracking to saves, so you can see how long a save has been played (only for 1.2 saves).
[*] Fixed problem in Tangle Trouble cave when FOV is not the default.
[*] Improved performance of power terminal graph.
[*] Plus several minor changes and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2 Preview - Machines and Decoration
notes.notes:
Here's a preview of the new machines, tech, and decoration items added in update 1.2

[h3]Map Table[/h3]
This new map table can be used to view each depth level, highlighting where all the caves are. It can show you which caves you have not visited, as well as listing all the scannables and collectables that you have found in them. No longer will you have to scour them one by one to find that last geoworm or drill tech that you missed on your first exploration, in order to 100% the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/d3c6fceb14d3a3ab14848af87cf2150d9be60bfa.png[/img]
[h3]Auto Driller[/h3]
This is a high powered machine that sends a drilling drone down to find a select resource type. It doesn't completely replace manual drilling and mining, but it's nice when you need just a little more resource to complete an upgrade or build. They require a lot of power to keep running, so you'll need to upgrade your power generation capabilities if you want several of these going at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/e8880edf771ede2924a142600a63cfcc420fe0f4.png[/img]
[h3]Alien Decoration[/h3]
Thanks to the efforts of a previous explorer, these alien decorational items can be printed once unlocked. They are fun little gizmos to have on desks and tables, providing more depth and personalisation to your base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/af45e3f8c43f8fffa6ea6693b3e6da7083c7eb0b.png[/img]
[h3]Critical Mining[/h3]
A new drill tool can be found in one of the new caves, which allows this new critical mining functionality.
When mining, a percentage determines the chance that the mined resources will be doubled. This percentage is reset to 0 when a resource is critically mined, but builds up when it's not. In general this means that more resources will be gained overall when mining, but it's been implemented in a fun way. It's always satisfying hearing that special beep when a mined resource is doubled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/15348401af06a227881507832a1facc88ca2812d.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2 Preview - New Depths
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Update 1.2, Deeper, will be releasing in full on the 19th of April, just under two weeks away. It's also available on the experimental branch on Steam right now, if you want to help test it, or just can't wait. For accessing the experimental branch just go into the games steam settings to switch the active branch to experimental. If you find any bugs or issues whilst trying it out, let me know about it on the [url=https://t.co/bcxp2uCLbD]discord server[/url]. 

I'll be releasing a couple of Steam news update 1.2 previews so you know what to expect for the update, like what I did with 1.1. Lets start off with the new depth levels.

[h3]Expanded 800m Depth Level[/h3]
I have converted the existing 800m depth level into a fully mineable level, with the addition of new caves, scannables, collectables, and resources. This depth level has a frosty theme, with cold and frigid caves, supporting only the toughest of plant life. There are also signs of many other explorers and unfortunate victims.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/ebd652dd8f5aa003f2a45e4ea3096efd5369a53d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/09a0900f2917576d2ef40edcf0cffe0943511a9b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/f66d88406a748a38f7cf314f2278d29bf3b85d25.png[/img]
[h3]New 1000m Depth Level[/h3]
This is a special end game depth level, and you'll immediate see that when you first visit it. It's purpose is tied with the new ending that I have added, so I won't go into it too much for the sake of spoliers. Just this sneak preview of one of the caves...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/299112044e831a8184461ab2ae8f1a782691adf7.png[/img]
[h3]New Resources[/h3]
More resources are to be found and mined! The primary being Aluminium and Chromium, with a new alloy recipe to make Chromium Steel. These new resources are used in end game machines and drill upgrades. I'll leave it for next weeks preview to talk about these new machines. The drill upgrade progression has been reworked to incorporate these new resources for the last upgrades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/6f0301dc62cdac55a3db76efa530f9e3b7e4b6a6.png[/img]

notes.title: GeoDepths Update 1.1 & Dev Log #14
notes.notes:
Hi all!

I'm glad to announce that update 1.1 is available now to play!
Including better drilling, unstable passages, more base customisation, machine enhancements, and more.
[url=discord.gg/tv9XvXB5n6]Join the discord[/url] to send any feedback or bug reports. 

Check out the dev log to see all the changes.

[previewyoutube=y9uVYYp5mKk;full][/previewyoutube]

Detailed Change Log
[list]
[*] New Unstable Passages that lead to new underground maps containing resources. These passages can only be traversed through and back once, but more will spawn around the main map. (Also a new set of resources that can only be found in these temporary maps)
[*] Drill offloading is now automatic.
[*] Overhauled item pickup/drop system to allow items to be placed down on surfaces. 
[*] Can create any number of the alien artifacts (they can be used as decoration now if you like).
[*] Created Item Dispenser which can print and dispense decorational items (Including resources).
[*] Changed up the interior of the drill, allowing any items to be placed in it (Not just the alien artifacts).
[*] Made the drill docking screen larger, and made it show stats on the drill, as well has being able to customise the drills terminal theme, and music. (Once researched)
[*] Improved the feel of drilling in the drill. The drill accelerates to top speed now, rather than it being instant, and rotation speed will scale with movement speed.
[*] Added room styles (Industrial and Quarters) alongside the Default style.
[*] Added empty shelves and podiums, for placing the decorational items on.
[*] Remade the power storage models.
[*] Overhauled the research system, removing research points, and making research cost resources. Also improved how the terminal displays the research, allowing yet to be unlocked research to be visible.
[*] Added refinery enhancement research, allowing Autoload and Overclock functions to be unlocked for both refinery types.
[*] Added generator enhancement research, allowing Autofill function to be unlocked for both generator types.
[*] Added these enhancement functions to be accessible from the Machine Command Terminal once unlocked.
[*] Improved the conveyor models and underground map sprites for the resources to be more varied.
[*] Allow sitting in chairs.
[*] Added new purple terminal theme.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 Preview - Drilling Improvements
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Firstly, Update 1 (version 1.1) is available to try out in the experimental branch of the game! Just go into the games steam settings to switch to experimental. It will remain just in the experimental branch for a week or two until I can confirm it's stable. If you find any bugs or issues whilst trying it out, let me know about it on the [url=https://t.co/bcxp2uCLbD]discord server[/url]. 

This week I'll show you the improvements I have made to the drill as a whole, as well as the new unstable passages that can be found.

[h3]Revamped Drill Interior[/h3]
With the addition of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2206140/announcements/detail/3889484725156031492]decorational items[/url] I just had to allow them to be placed in the drill, so I changed up part of its interior to allow for this. I added a long bench, and a couple smaller ones, where items can be placed. I also removed the artifacts cabinet that was there before, as they can just be placed on the bench now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/820a392ddb4b33f9cc5748e94d24d7cb8b2d777d.png[/img]
[h3]Expanded Drill Screen[/h3]
The docking screen in the drill has been super sized, for two purposes. The first is so it can contain a drill stats window, which can be used to check all the drills capabilities at a glance. This is based on all the drill upgrades that have been performed so far and what drill tools have been unlocked. The second is to house a drill ambience config, which once unlocked, will allow the drills terminal theming to be changed, as well as playing music in the drill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/11665e654a3ea9ef9ef79bcfeaffee540b6385f0.png[/img]
[h3]Unstable Passages[/h3]
There have been rare reports of people completely drilling out the underground map, and mining all the ore available, which is complete madness. Enough ore should spawn so there is plenty enough needed for both progression and base building, plus loads extra. But people really enjoy the drilling and mining, so I just had to think of a way to facilitate doing this infinitely. So I thought of the idea of other underground maps that you can traverse to, which contain all the same resources as the main map (based on which depth level you are on). You get to these other underground maps through unstable passages, which will collapse once you come back from them. This will mean that these temporary underground maps are a one time use only, but more unstable passages will spawn leading to new maps, allowing for an infinite supply of drilling, mining, and resources. As a bonus, I have also added a special kind of rare resource that can only be found in these temporary maps, but you'll just have to find them for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/5af76dcdb69a49f5c0427b2a934ad8db206eb595.png[/img]
I have also tweaked how it feels to move the drill, by making it so that the drill will accelerate to top speed, rather than instantly reaching it. This makes it a lot easier to make small movement adjustments when the drills speed has been upgraded to the max. I have also made it so that the drills rotation speed scales with movement speed, so that the faster the drill is moving the faster it will rotate.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Preview - Refinery, Generator, and Research Improvements
notes.notes:
Hi all!

This week I'll show off the new Refinery and Generator enhancement upgrades, to allow autoloading, autofilling, and overclocking, as well as the changes I have made to the research system.

[h3]Refinery and Generator Enhancements[/h3]
I have added research items to unlock more advanced refinery and generator functionalities. Both the basic and alloy refineries can have autoload activated on them, which will automatically load the currently selected resources when they are available and refine them, rather than having to tell each refinery to start manually. These refineries can also have overclock activated, which will reduce how much time they need to refine, but will also increase how much power they require. 
Similar to autoload, the generators have been given the autofill enhancement, allowing them to automatically fill up on the fuel they use when activated. 
These enhancement functionalities can be toggled on and off globally using the machine command terminal, ensuring that it still has a use once they are unlocked. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/d8324cec71fabf578937f38f7ef031ceee8ad323.png[/img]
[h3]Research Overhaul[/h3]
I was never too happy with how the research system worked, using abstract research points that you gain from scanning things. It wasn't too clear where the research points come from, and by the mid point of the game you had so much points that you never had to worry about having enough anymore. So I scrapped the idea of research points, and made it so that research costs resources instead. I'm a lot happier with this, as it provides a greater sense of achievement to performing the research, rather than it just being something that basically comes for free.
Another smaller change is that I have made it so you can see future research items that are yet to be unlocked by scanning resources. This way you have more of an idea of what you are working towards, when finding and scanning new resources

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/4f81ea6426c7ed190784bebcc59088da003fc84b.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1 Preview - Base Building Improvements
notes.notes:
Hi all!

This week I'll show off the various additions and improvements to the base building in GeoDepths, to be included in the first update. 

[h3]Room Types[/h3]
Firstly I have added two new room styles to the game, alongside the default room style, to give base building more variability. Using the new Industrial room style you can create rooms to contain refineries and other machines. The new Quarters room style is more homely and can be used to house bed and lounge areas of your base. When building a room now, there is the choice between which ever room styles you have unlocked, and you can also switch existing rooms between the styles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/09b2d5b557015de98c091bcbaaf6ea6c7093f0b2.png[/img]
[h3]Empty Shelves and Podiums[/h3]
To be able to better decorate your base using the new decorational items, I have included more buildables to be able to hold them. I have included an empty variant of the standing and wall shelves, as well as a podium. 
Here's the previous post about how I have added these [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2206140/announcements/detail/3889484725156031492]Decorational Items[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/6e3c708504bedd7185de2d95ac93c8461a3abd4e.png[/img]
[h3]New Power Storage Models[/h3]
I was never too happy with how the power storage machines looked. So I went ahead and updated their models to better fit the style used for the rest of the base buildables. I even added little screens to them to show how much power storage they provide.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/a2607d19044279a58635089afe04165433108564.png[/img]
I have also made many other small miscellaneous improvements. Such as tidying up the models used for the default room style, and making it so you can sit down on chairs and couches.

notes.title: Update 1.1 Preview - Decorational Items
notes.notes:
Hi all!

For each of the following weeks leading up to the release of Update 1 for my game GeoDepths, I will be showing off what I have been working on, giving you more insight into what to expect.

For the first week I'll be showing off this new item printing/dispensing system. This is something that I had in mind for the full release, but never got around to implementing it. So it was one of the first things that I worked on for this post release update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/649354ec90b67b10094fbb411503251652ca707a.png[/img]
[h3]The Item Dispenser[/h3]
Using the Item Dispenser you can select many different models, figurines and terrariums to 3D print. Once printed they can be picked up and put down on any surface. Some are animated, like the Newton's Cradle, and some require cave plants to be scanned to be unlocked, such as each of the terrariums.
All these items and resources can be placed back into the Item Dispenser, in order to recycle them, allowing you to change your mind about what to decorate your base with at any time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/12b446a48549398c87666145fc171b191991f159.png[/img]
[h3]Resource Items[/h3]
You can also dispense each of the resource ingots and ores, which lead me to improve and update some of the models of these. There will also be some special (yet to be revealed) new resource items that you definitely will want to show off in your base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/db55a0db9458dfc7427a52149a3240aab113a31e.png[/img]

notes.title: GeoDepths Post Release Updates Plan
notes.notes:
First of all a huge thanks to all those that have played and given feedback for my game GeoDepths! It's been a crazy experience releasing my first game. You've all been amazing!

I initially didn't intend on doing any post release content. I was excited to reach the finish line of the development journey of my first game, and was looking forward to starting the next one.
But as more and more people played the game, and provided great feedback, I was eventually inspired enough to look at adding more to the game.

So since then I have been collecting ideas of what I could do, which will be both feasible and impactful. The changes and additions would have to complement the existing game, without requiring me to spend another year rewriting how everything works. So I came up with enough ideas that I liked, which could then be separated into two camps. Those that expanded the current game, and those that extended it. Leading me to decide on two content updates, which I have aptly nicknamed Denser and Deeper.

The first update will focus on expanding the existing content of the game, improving and enhancing the drilling and building systems.

The second will add more depth levels to explore, along with new caves and resources, and more lore and story that will lead into a third ending for the game.

The estimated release months for these two updates are January and April, with the updates going into an experimental branch for a short time before being pushed into the main game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43253192/f09134c58c2bb9975134499cb7fc1971e574ab2f.png[/img]
